replies.text:
Checks (step 2):
- Automated abuse reachable: design says "Sign-up only needs an email address" and credit granted on sign-up — present; covered by listed threat 1 (mass sign-up farming) and listed threat 2 (code enumeration). Email/SMS flooding: design states no email sending, not present. Scraping of returned data: no page or API output described, not present.
- Staff/admin/moderator screens showing user-supplied content: design mentions none ("Each user gets a referral code... both accounts receive $10 credit"), not present.
- Money movement / approvals without a record: credits of "$10 credit" move value; covered by listed threat 7 (no link between a credited referral and identity, fraud cannot be unwound).
- Cacheable personal/financial pages or documents: design describes no pages, statements or documents, not present.
- Attacker-controlled text into logs, CSV, emails, headers: only field stated is "an email address" with no export, log or downstream consumer named, not present.
- Unconfirmed reviewer items: budget exhaustion / account-table growth is the same automated sign-up run as listed threat 1 (its consequence), client-trusted credit amount and concurrency double-credit depend on build details not stated in the design, alias self-referral is a sub-case of listed threat 5, code-validation disclosure is a sub-case of listed threats 2 and 6. No new gap.
